integrity: Every nontrivial visibility test reduces to a same-part distance-two pair, which is visible exactly when the complement contains a vertex outside that part. The required pair types give three exact complement classifications, and the polynomial formulas follow by disjoint counting of invalid complements. A standalone checker independently evaluates geodesic visibility and all coefficients through order nine.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The total visibility polynomial is excluded from the claim.
The 2025 balanced complete-bipartite formulas are a strong precursor.
The 2026 complete-multipartite paper covers the ordinary scalar maximum but not the three all-cardinality enumerators.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
title: Three visibility polynomials of complete multipartite graphs
